stages.title: Global and scalable design
stages.paragraph: Developing global anti-fraud intelligence goes far beyond simple data processing. You need to create an experience that adapts to different languages, currencies, time zones, and devices. To integrate the applications developed by ClearSale, it became essential to create a robust design system, capable of guaranteeing scalability, consistency and efficiency.

stages.title: A multidisciplinary initiative
stages.paragraph: One was developed based on Material Design 3 and had all its prototyping carried out in Figma, promoting collaboration between teams and continuous validation of flows. Its components were implemented as Web Components, allowing integration with different frameworks and keeping ClearSale's design system efficient and scalable.

stages.title: Local advances, global impacts
stages.paragraph: At the end of its first year, One replaced the Brazilian and international portals, consolidating itself as ClearSale's main product. Since then, it has evolved to integrate all of the company's products, unifying technology, interface and, above all, the user experience.

one.highlight: "Global by serving users in all countries, but also by meeting the company's internal needs"

stages.title: Connecting humans and computers
stages.paragraph: Communicating involves more than words – gestures, intonation and looks are part of it. We are complex, while our computers ignore these details. If a cell phone could describe its user, perhaps it would just see a hand with a giant finger. But what if we could give computers a 'soul,' allowing them to understand subtle aspects of human nature?

stages.title: Capturing Frequencies of Consciousness
stages.paragraph: Soul uses electroencephalography (EEG) to capture brain frequencies and understand the user's mental state. With a portable EEG, we can continuously measure frequencies generated by the brain and our levels of attention and meditation, allowing the computer to detect changes in the user's mental state in real time, without the user noticing.

stages.title: A smart lighting prototype
stages.paragraph: To prove this concept, I developed an application that controls a lamp whose color and intensity automatically adjust to the user's unconscious needs, helping with tasks such as concentration, relaxation or sleep. The system processes data in real time and adapts the lighting until the desired objective is achieved, without the need for user intervention.

soul.highlight: "If I had to summarize your project in one word, I would choose resilience"

stages.title: Connecting people, services and culture
stages.paragraph: Operating throughout Brazil, Sesc needed a digital platform capable of representing its diversity of services and audiences. More than redesigning a website, the challenge was to create an inclusive, accessible and scalable experience, connecting cultural, sporting, educational and social actions in a fluid and intuitive way.

stages.title: Leadership in a strategic project
stages.paragraph: Sesc's IT, Design and Marketing teams worked in synergy to align technical needs, communication and user experience. It was up to me to be the central link between all these areas, coordinating our internal processes and demands and also the outsourced company responsible for developing the project, ensuring coherence between planning, execution and final delivery.

stages.title: Results that connect Brazil to Sesc
stages.paragraph: The new Sesc website was launched in 2021, the company's 75th anniversary, and quickly established itself as one of the main channels for promoting Sesc services throughout Brazil. With an accessible interface and organized content, the portal began to connect millions of Brazilians to the institution's actions, strengthening its social mission through a modern, inclusive and strategic digital presence.

sesc.highlight: "Sesc.com.br now reflects the diversity and national reach of the institution"

stages.title: Combining creativity and viability
stages.paragraph: To create a successful game it is necessary to balance creativity, technical limitations and market demands. For a solo developer, this balance becomes even more challenging. The big question is: how to create a game mechanic that is viable to implement alone and, at the same time, has commercial potential after launch?

stages.title: The game is born piece by piece
stages.paragraph: Game Changer is a turn-based strategy game prototype, made in the Godot engine and inspired by classics such as Final Fantasy Tactics and Into the Breach. Here, each movement transforms the battlefield: terrain can be destroyed, units pushed in a chain and the scenario changes with each decision, requiring flexible tactics and offering a constant strategic challenge.

stages.title: Changing the Game
stages.paragraph: As a game, Game Changer offers a strategic and deeply original experience. But the project goes further: it is also a practical research into what can be created with passion, organization and technology. By providing a complete framework of feasibility — technical, economic, artistic, etc. —, it also establishes itself as a reference for other independent developers.

gamechanger.highlight: "Position, push and predict. Victory is less about attacking and more about dominating space"

stages.title: A language that represents me
stages.paragraph: Building my own visual identity was an exercise in patience and self-knowledge. I wanted something that was more than a portfolio — I needed to create a language that communicated who I am, how I think and how I work. The challenge was to translate this into a cohesive, professional and authorial visual experience that would extend to all points of contact of my professional presentation.

stages.title: From design to code
stages.paragraph: The first step was to design a brand and a design system that reflected my personality and style. I structured this entire visual in Figma, composing typographic systems, tokens and a library of reusable components. This base culminated in the implementation of this same website in a 1:1 way in Vue, with componentization, dynamic routing and modular SCSS.

stages.title: End-to-end design
stages.paragraph: This project reflects my ability to combine artistic sensitivity and technical mastery in a complete process — from aesthetic conception to design system, from prototyping to implementation. Mastering the technologies involved allows me to propose viable and impactful solutions. It is an authorial expression that delivers value by transforming intention into experience.

ericemanuel.highlight: "This project is me: in pixels, code and purpose"

stages.title: Centralizing experiences, connecting people
stages.paragraph: Tourism, sport, leisure, health, education. Sesc is present throughout Brazil with a broad and transformative role – but it is not always easy for the public to access this information. What if it were possible to bring the same feeling of exploring all of this in person to the virtual world?

stages.title: One app, multiple possibilities
stages.paragraph: Sesc Go is an app focused on exploration and discovery, offering users a macro view of the institution and also providing detailed access to the activities of each of its units. It was also the first application of Sesc's new design system, providing a modern, accessible and open source-based experience.

stages.title: An integrated and intuitive digital ecosystem
stages.paragraph: The concept of Sesc+ and the scope of the design system made it even easier for Sesc to get closer to its audience. By combining a panoramic vision and attention to detail, the project has established itself as a reference in user experience and innovation within the company and in the public-private sector.

sescgo.highlight: "A journey of empathy and rediscovery of how Sesc communicates with people"

stages.label: Privacy Policy
stages.title: Your data in Danei
stages.paragraph: Danei is a personal finance organizer developed by Eric Emanuel. This policy explains what data we use, why we use it, and how you can manage it. Privacy contact: danei@ericemanuel.ee.

stages.label: Accounts
stages.title: Sign-in is optional
stages.paragraph: You can use local features without signing in. If you sign in with Google or Apple, Firebase Authentication uses your sign-in identifiers and may receive your name, email address, and profile photo. This helps us identify your Danei account and protect access. Deleting Danei does not delete your Google or Apple account.

stages.label: Financial data
stages.title: Local and synchronized data
stages.paragraph: Environments, transactions, amounts, categories, notes, goals, and preferences are stored on your device. When you enable synchronization or use a shared environment, the related data is also stored in Firebase so it can be synchronized and accessed by authorized members.

stages.label: Shared environments
stages.title: What other members can see
stages.paragraph: Members of a shared environment can view its records. If you leave the environment or delete your account, those records remain available to the other authorized members.

stages.label: Backups
stages.title: Copies in Google Drive and iCloud
stages.paragraph: Where supported, Danei can save backups to Google Drive or iCloud. When you delete your account, Danei attempts to remove app-managed backups it can access. You may need to remove other copies from your cloud account, devices, or exported files yourself.

stages.label: Danei Plus
stages.title: How subscriptions are checked
stages.paragraph: Google Play and the App Store handle purchases and payments. Danei uses Qonversion to check subscription status using technical purchase information. Danei does not handle your payment details.

stages.label: Notifications
stages.title: Optional alerts
stages.paragraph: If you enable notifications, Firebase Cloud Messaging may process device identifiers, preferences, and the information needed to send alerts about shared environments.

stages.label: Providers and security
stages.title: Who helps provide Danei
stages.paragraph: Danei uses Google/Firebase for sign-in, synchronization, storage, and notifications; Google or Apple for sign-in and backups; and Qonversion for subscription checks. We restrict access to synchronized data, use encrypted network connections, and do not sell personal or financial data. Providers may process data outside your country under applicable safeguards.

stages.label: Retention and deletion
stages.title: What remains after deletion
stages.paragraph: We keep account data while needed for your account and enabled features. Deleting your account removes data linked to it from Danei services and attempts to remove accessible app-managed backups. Shared records and copies outside our control may remain. Limited technical records may be kept for security, legal duties, or to complete deletion, and removed when no longer needed. Deleting your account does not cancel a subscription.

stages.label: Your rights
stages.title: Manage your information
stages.paragraph: You can update your profile, manage notification permissions on your device, and delete your account in Danei. Depending on applicable law, you may also request access, correction, portability, or deletion of your data, or object to certain uses. Contact danei@ericemanuel.ee. See the Terms of Use. If you cannot access the app, request account deletion online.

stages.label: Children
stages.title: Not intended for children
stages.paragraph: Danei is not designed for children. We do not intentionally request personal information from children.

stages.label: Changes
stages.title: Updates to this policy
stages.paragraph: We may update this policy when Danei or the services it uses change. The current version will be published here.

stages.label: Danei Support
stages.title: Help with the app
stages.paragraph: This is the official Danei support channel. For questions about features, sign-in, backups, or subscriptions, contact Eric Emanuel at danei@ericemanuel.ee.

stages.label: Data and sync
stages.title: Your information may be stored locally and in the cloud
stages.paragraph: Danei keeps financial information locally and, when synchronization is active, uses Firebase to provide access to shared environments. Backups may be stored in Google Drive or iCloud.

stages.label: Policies
stages.title: Documents available online
stages.paragraph: Read the Privacy Policy and Terms of Use for information about data processing and Danei Plus conditions.

stages.label: Account deletion
stages.title: You control your Danei account
stages.paragraph: Open your Danei profile and select “Delete my account” to remove your profile, linked personal data, and app-managed backups. Shared environments remain available to other members. For assistance, contact danei@ericemanuel.ee. Deleting an account does not cancel an active subscription. If you cannot access the app, request deletion on our website.

stages.label: Terms of Use
stages.title: Using Danei
stages.paragraph: Danei is a personal finance organizer. By using it, you agree to these terms. Read our Privacy Policy to learn how your information is handled.

stages.label: The service
stages.title: Organize your finances
stages.paragraph: Danei helps you record transactions, categories, goals, and reports. It is not a bank, payment service, financial adviser, or investment service. Danei does not move money for you.

stages.label: Accounts
stages.title: Keep your access secure
stages.paragraph: You can use local features without signing in. Google or Apple sign-in supports account features such as sharing and synchronization. Keep your device and sign-in credentials secure.

stages.label: Shared environments
stages.title: Share responsibly
stages.paragraph: Only share records with people authorized to see them. If you leave a shared environment or delete your account, its records remain available to the other authorized members.

stages.label: Backups
stages.title: Keep your copies safe
stages.paragraph: Danei offers local or cloud backups where supported. Keep exported files secure and check your backups before changing or restoring devices.

stages.label: Danei Plus
stages.title: Manage billing in the store
stages.paragraph: Paid features require an active subscription. Google Play or the App Store shows the price, billing period, renewal terms, and offers before purchase. Subscriptions may renew automatically. Manage or cancel them in the store where you subscribed. Deleting your Danei account does not stop billing.

stages.label: Responsible use
stages.title: Respect access and security
stages.paragraph: Do not access other people’s environments without permission, misuse shared information, interfere with Danei, or bypass its security.

stages.label: Availability
stages.title: Features may change
stages.paragraph: Some features depend on your device, internet connection, or other services. We may update Danei for security, fixes, or compatibility. Uninterrupted access cannot be guaranteed.

stages.label: Account deletion
stages.title: You can delete your account
stages.paragraph: Use “Delete my account” in your Danei profile. Your account and linked personal data are removed, but shared records remain available to other members. If you cannot access the app, request deletion online. See our Privacy Policy for details.

stages.label: Contact and changes
stages.title: Questions about these terms
stages.paragraph: For questions, email danei@ericemanuel.ee. We may update these terms, and the current version will be available on this page.

stages.label: Account deletion
stages.title: Delete your Danei account
stages.paragraph: You can delete your account in Danei using “Delete my account” in your profile. If you cannot access the app, send a deletion request by email. You do not need to reinstall the app.

stages.label: Verification
stages.title: Confirm the account is yours
stages.paragraph: Tell us which Danei account you want to delete, preferably from the email address linked to it. We may ask for additional verification. Never send passwords, sign-in codes, or financial records.

stages.label: Your data
stages.title: What is deleted
stages.paragraph: After verification, we delete your Danei account and personal data linked to it in our services, and attempt to remove app-managed cloud backups we can access. You may need to remove data stored on your device or copies in your own Google Drive or iCloud account. Limited technical records may remain when required for security or legal reasons.

stages.label: Shared environments
stages.title: Shared records remain
stages.paragraph: Your membership in shared environments is removed, but their records remain available to other authorized members. Danei cannot delete copies exported or stored outside the app.

stages.label: Danei Plus
stages.title: Subscriptions are separate
stages.paragraph: Deleting your account does not cancel Danei Plus. To stop future charges, cancel your subscription in Google Play or the App Store. See our Privacy Policy for more about data deletion.
